<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 2 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== The Marvelous Land of Oz ==

Saw-Horse est un cheval de bois animé, capable de galoper et de parler. Sur la route menant à la Cité d'Émeraude, il file comme un cheval de course tandis que Jack Pumpkinhead se cramponne à un poteau, et les tours et dômes verts de la cité finissent par apparaître à l'horizon. Craignant le feu en raison de la sécheresse de son bois, qui selon lui s'enflammerait comme du petit bois, il manifeste une vive agitation face à ce danger. Il propose également de « secouer » une jeune fille, suggestion à laquelle le Bûcheron de Fer-Blanc répond qu'il convient au contraire de la traiter avec douceur et de la renvoyer comblée de bijoux.

=== Events ===

* The newly animated Saw-Horse is disoriented, unable to see its own body, and knocks Jack Pumpkinhead over while circling.
* The Saw-Horse ignores Tip's shouted 'Whoa' until Jack points out it has no ears to hear with.
* Tip whittles ears from tree bark and fastens them to the Saw-Horse's head.
* Startled by the sound of Jack's voice near its new ears, the Saw-Horse bolts, stumbles into a gopher-hole, and lands upside down.
* Tip rights the Saw-Horse, repairs a broken ear, and teaches it the commands Whoa, Get-Up, and Trot.
* Tip explains they are traveling to the Emerald City to see the Scarecrow, with Jack riding on the Saw-Horse's back.
* Tip carves and hammers a wooden post into the Saw-Horse's back for Jack to hold onto while riding.
* Tip and Jack Pumpkinhead resume their journey toward the Emerald City atop the Saw-Horse.
* Tip rides the Saw-Horse across the river while Jack wades and holds the horse's tail; all get wet.
* Tip runs behind the galloping Saw-Horse holding its tail, but the branch breaks and he is left behind on the road.
* Unaware Tip fell behind, Jack and the Saw-Horse race on and arrive at the green wall of the Emerald City.
* A Soldier with Green Whiskers leads Jack and the Saw-Horse through the emerald city streets to the royal palace.
* The Scarecrow has the Saw-Horse (locked in the treasury as a supposed jewel) brought out, and he, Tip, and Jack Pumpkinhead mount it, tied together with a clothesline, leaving the Royal Army behind.
* The Saw-Horse bursts through the gate, knocking over several of Jinjur's girl guards and the new Guardian of the Gate as the trio escapes the City.
* The Saw-Horse races west at reckless speed until it leaps into a river, plunging all three riders into the water.
* Tip, the Scarecrow, and the Pumpkinhead Jack are dunked in a river when the Saw-Horse struggles while carrying them across.
* The group remounts the Saw-Horse and resumes traveling toward the Tin Woodman, with Jack and the horse bickering along the way.
* The Tin Woodman welcomes Tip, Jack Pumpkinhead, and the Saw-Horse, and explains the engraved star on his chest covers the patch where the Wizard placed his heart.
* The group escapes the sunflower field by riding forward with closed eyes, following the Pumpkinhead and Saw-Horse.
* The Scarecrow navigates by the sun since no witchcraft can alter it, but the Saw-Horse steps into a rabbit hole and breaks its leg.
* With no trees or materials nearby to repair the Saw-Horse, the group sits down to think of a solution.
* The Saw-Horse's broken leg cannot be fixed since Jack Pumpkinhead must ride; the Woggle-Bug suggests using one of Jack's wooden legs as a replacement.
* Nick Chopper amputates Jack's left leg and fits it to the Saw-Horse, prompting bickering between Jack and the Saw-Horse before the group resumes travel toward the Emerald City.
* The Tin Woodman chops down the Saw-Horse's new leg because it is too long, letting the wooden horse walk more comfortably.
* The Gump flies south with Tip, Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, Jack Pumpkinhead, Woggle-Bug, and Saw-Horse aboard.
* Jackdaws attack the group perched in the Gump's nest, and the Tin Woodman fights them off with his axe while the Saw-Horse kicks with its wooden legs.
* The Saw-Horse solves the counting puzzle by suggesting they start counting at one-half.
* Glinda pursues the Griffin on the tireless Saw-Horse while Tip and the others follow by air aboard the Gump.
* The Griffin tires crossing the desert sands while the untiring Saw-Horse closes the distance.
</div>
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 4 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz ==

The Sawhorse is a creature encountered in the company of the Cowardly Lion, the King of the Forest and vassal of Princess Ozma, and the Hungry Tiger, the terror of the jungle. It introduces the newcomer known as the Real Horse to these two in a calm tone and with as much dignity as it can muster, bowing its head toward them. The Sawhorse openly admires the Real Horse, calling it a beautiful animal. When the Scarecrow proposes a race between the Sawhorse and the Cab-horse, the Sawhorse draws back, protesting that such a contest would not be fair.

=== Events ===

* In Oz they reunite with the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, Billina, the Cowardly Lion, the Hungry Tiger, and the Woggle-Bug, ending with a race between Jim and the Sawhorse.
* Jim loses race against Sawhorse and kicks it in anger, breaking its leg and ear; Hungry Tiger tackles Jim in response.
* Ozma crowns Sawhorse "Prince of Horses" and Tin Woodman repairs its leg and ear.
</div>
